user_instructions: 引擎里有gh么？我在引擎内脱离codebuddy 如何建立issue？
引擎里引导用户打开gh登录这条有了么？

baseline.gap_found: Before this change the guide only checked that a gh executable exists; a logged-out gh failed at create time with the generic 'GitHub command failed; check local gh login and repository access' and no login guidance.

change.bridge: gh_authenticated runs read-only 'gh auth status --hostname github.com'; issue-draft returns gh_authenticated and gh_login_command; issue-create and issue-start return error gh_unauthenticated with login_command and make no API, create or edit call. Adapter version 1.2.0 -> 1.2.1.
change.editor: AIChatIssueGuide::gh_login_text shows the copyable '<gh> auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web' command in the draft preview, the create failure and the start failure; the guide stays in place and '确认' or '开始' retries.
change.not_done_by_design: The editor never runs gh auth login itself; login is interactive and stays in the user's terminal.

validation.check: scons platform=macos target=editor tests=yes allow_unsupported_apple_clang=yes use_volk=yes accesskit=no -j8

new_cases: [AIChat] Issue guide explains gh login without running it

validation.flow: unbound send -> 新建 -> 1 -> 默认 -> guide-e2e-1 -> preview shows login guidance -> 确认 while logged out shows login command, nothing created -> scene writes the fixture login flag -> 确认 creates #42 -> 开始 -> original message completes one model turn

validation.note: Run without --max-frame-gap as before: the cancel scene ends before frame gaps are sampled.

fixtures: Isolated HOME, fake gh whose auth status fails until a flag file exists, fake node context output, loopback model fixture; no real repository, no real framework admission.
not_covered: The in-editor guide, including the login prompt, was not used against the real GitHub account or repository.
A gh that is logged in but lacks repository write permission still reports the generic gh command failure.
No Windows or other platform build.
unknown_reason: The CodeBuddy host does not expose usage or cost accounting for this task.
